Package growthbook.sdk.java.multiusermode.internal

Class GlobalContextManager

java.lang.Object
growthbook.sdk.java.multiusermode.internal.GlobalContextManager
public final class GlobalContextManager extends Object
INTERNAL: not part of the supported API. Public only because GrowthBookClient lives in the parent package — treat its signatures as free to change without a major version bump. Internal coordinator for the client-level GlobalContext. Keeps feature state updates and evaluation context creation outside the public facade.
